description: Passage search over episode summary sections AND verbatim transcripts: pass a concept or question ("who discussed interconnection queues") and get the closest passages, each with its episode, section, kind, rank, and score. `mode` picks the retriever: auto (recommended — the server chooses from the query's shape), semantic (cosine), keyword (BM25 — exact acronyms, names, and numbers like PJM, FERC 2023, 800 MW), or hybrid (both, fused by rank). `mode` in the response is the retriever that ran; `rank` is the ordering. Covers every summarized public episode, including AI-feed shows no weekly digest cited. Use `search` instead for names, typos, people, companies, or shows. English only. Returns passages, not an answer.

kind.description: Restrict to summary or transcript; omit for both

mode.description: auto (recommended; the server picks from the query), semantic (cosine, default), keyword (BM25, no embedder), or hybrid (rank fusion)

per_episode.description: Max passages per episode across both kinds (default 3)

q.description: Concept, question, or exact terms (≥2 chars)

show.description: Feed key, display name, or /s/<num> id — restrict to one show

name: semantic_search

degraded.description: True when auto fell back to the leg that still works

embed_model.description: null in keyword mode (no embedder call)

mode.description: The retriever that ran: semantic, keyword, or hybrid

mode_requested.description: What the caller asked for, including auto

digest_slug.description: Newest digest citing the episode; '' for AI-feed-only

rank.description: Position returned; the ordering in every mode

score.description: Cosine similarity (1.0 = identical) in semantic mode; null otherwise

route.description: Why auto chose its leg: quote, lexicon, digit, camel, semantic; null for explicit modes

title: Find passages by meaning
